adversarial_short_region.interpretation: Forced compaction is catastrophically worse when branch regions are too short to amortize regrouping overhead; an adequacy gate must bypass such regions.

prior_art_boundary: Dynamic Warp Formation, Thread Block Compaction, CAPRI-style adequacy prediction, and Shader Execution Reordering are established prior art. Cross-warp compaction and generic compaction gating are not Vektor novelty claims.
claim_boundary: Synthetic issue-slot accounting over reorder-safe regions. The oracle gate has perfect future knowledge and is an upper bound. The model does not yet include register migration energy/timing, cache-locality disruption, memory timing under reordering, synchronization/barrier semantics, starvation, physical timing, area, power, or RTL.
